name: Meet the Animals
overview:
Meet the Animals is an animated educational series created by Little Fox, designed to introduce young learners to wildlife from around the world.

Each episode focuses on a different wild animal, using real photos and simple, easy-to-understand sentences to teach fun facts about where they live, what they eat, and what makes them special. The series features a question-and-answer style that makes learning interactive and engaging.

With over 60 episodes, each about 3 minutes long with subtitles, it is an excellent resource for children to practice English while exploring the natural world
